implementation: Complete FFmpeg ZIP and pinned platform resource manifests include every shipped file and empty directory, including licenses/docs. Archive paths, types, normalized duplicates/case collisions, files-versus-directories, total/count/individual-byte caps and SHA256 are verified before admission. Reused extracted trees reject missing/extra/changed entries without repair or deletion.

Windows ancestor handles refuse rename/reparse replacement throughout each operation; source handles reject reparse/non-file before reading and exclude concurrent write/delete. Manifest-selected create-new copies rehash destination bytes. Failed outputs remain for inspection. Approved acquisition streams are bounded and hash checked into create-new random pending files; source inputs are never overwritten. No HTTP request was made by these tests.

Portable resource source/target trailing directory separators are normalized before exact approved lookup and relative manifest validation, including the actual Tauri resource mappings. The final ZIP is generated from its combined positive manifest, then checked entry-for-entry and byte-for-byte. No recursive wildcard package copy remains.

Optional WebView2 runtime is a separately named initial-install ZIP and sidecar with updaterCompatible=false. The ordinary ZIP keeps the five existing updater roots. Release preparation checks sidecar/inner marker/version/name/typed flags/bounds/complete manifest and exact archive hash, then binds the verified proof to the actual signed buffer staged with create-new writes rather than re-reading a possibly changed source during copy.
